raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week General Fitness Programme for 58-year-old male, post-MI, cardiac rehab cleared for moderate-intensity"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational strength with moderate-intensity, heart-rate limited workouts; cardiovascular base; safe resistance training avoiding Valsalva; no maximal lifts"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Intro to safe resistance and cardio base":
        warmup:
          cardio_modality treadmill walk incline 10% 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Chest_press_machine 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Lat_pull_down 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          treadmill_walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Technique and endurance":
        warmup:
          cycling_relaxed 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Chest_press_machine 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Overhead_press_dumbbell 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Hip_abduction_machine 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progression and cadence":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Chest_press_machine 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell_db_cinch_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          treadmill_walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Recovery and technique focus":
        warmup:
          cycle_easy 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Lateral_raise_machine 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Tricep_pushdown_cable 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Bicep_curl_machine 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Calf_raise_sit_down 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Volume build with RPE control":
        warmup:
          bike_incline 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg_press 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_row 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Chest_press_machine 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Lat_pull_down 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Leg_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          bike 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Push-pull balance":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell_db_floor_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_row 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Shoulder_external_rotation 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Hip_adductor_machine 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability and proprioception":
        warmup:
          elliptical_ergometer 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Cable_resisted_diagonal_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Chest_press_machine 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Plank_supported_side_30s each side
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Conditioning block (no HR exceedance)">
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Treadmill_walk_incline 15 minutes total as 1+1+1+1 with 60s easy/60s moderate
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength foundation with controlled tempo":
        warmup:
          cycle 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Chest_press_machine 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Lat_pull_down 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          cycle 5 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Mixed modality with recovery":
        warmup:
          treadmill 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell_db_floor_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Leg_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          Hip_abductor_machine 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Tempo intervals at safe HR":
        warmup:
          cycle 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Walk_jog intervals on treadmill: 6 intervals of 60s brisk walk (below HR 115) / 90s easy, total ~15 minutes
          Leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          idle_walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Graduation to maintenance plan":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Chest_press_machine 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Lat_pull_down 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use two dots, e.g., 3x12..15
- Sets always come first: 3x12
- RPE goes after sets/reps: 3x12 rpe 5
- Rest in seconds: rest 90 seconds
